name: Crawling Claw

name: Cyclops
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition. Checked against the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The conversion puts the cyclops at Medium size. Powerful Build changes weight capacity. The build uses the species AC formula, 14 + Dexterity.

name: Darkmantle
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: pp. 38–39, Darkmantle Traits. See p. 8 for somatic components.
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition. Checked against the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The active traits give 30 ft. walking speed. The design commentary references 10 ft. in the baseline monster. The profile and the build use the traits. Crush is the printed anatomy-specific permission to grapple with its tentacles.

name: Demilich
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: pp. 41–42, Demilich Traits. See pp. 7–8 for undead healing and somatic components.
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition. Checked against the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The player traits list Small. The design notes describe Tiny. Aster’s six known spells use verbal or somatic components or material components covered by the skull focus. Fear comes from the separate daily Howl. The copper tally and silted bell are original NPC details.
